title: The Moon's Phases Aren't Earth's Shadow
post_title: The Moon's Phases Aren't Earth's Shadow | QuantaTale
post_description: The Moon changes shape every night—but Earth isn't casting that shadow. Discover the science behind it. Sources: https://science.nasa.gov/moon/top-moon-questions/ https://supernova.eso.org/exhibition/0206/?lang=en #Science #ScienceFacts #Education #QuantaTale
narration: The Moon does not make its own light. Sunlight illuminates half of it, all the time. As the Moon travels around Earth, our viewing angle changes, so we see different portions of that sunlit half. That is what creates the crescent, quarter and full Moon. Earth's shadow only falls on the Moon during a lunar eclipse. So the ordinary phases are a change in perspective, not Earth's shadow.
